how_to_play.title: One village. Two sides.
how_to_play.intro: A tiny guide to a very bad night.
how_to_play.gather.label: 01 / GATHER
how_to_play.gather.title: Invite the usual suspects.
how_to_play.gather.description: Create a room and share the code, or find a public gathering. Everyone gets a secret role. Some get a much darker agenda.
how_to_play.deceive.label: 02 / DECEIVE
how_to_play.deceive.title: A little ritual after dark.
how_to_play.deceive.description: The cult chants. The Oracle investigates. The Veilweaver bends the truth. By day, every story deserves a second look.
how_to_play.decide.label: 03 / DECIDE
how_to_play.decide.title: Trust your gut. Or don’t.
how_to_play.decide.description: Discuss and vote to banish a suspect. Unmask all cultists to save the town—or finish the ritual to wake what waits below.
rules.summary: The finer points of impending doom
rules.phases.title: Night, discussion, vote. Repeat.
rules.phases.description: Living players act once per night and cast one final vote per day. A tie for most votes, or abstention winning the vote, banishes nobody. If you miss a deadline, your action is forfeited. Banished players can watch until the match ends.
rules.role_card.title: Your role card tells the truth.
rules.role_card.description: Cultists know each other and share one mission. The Oracle sees an alignment, but the Veilweaver can reverse one player’s reading for that night. Your own role and mission are never disguised.
rules.curses.title: Curses wake at dawn.
rules.curses.description: The Veilweaver curses the player they veil; Acolytes may choose a curse target while chanting. Soul Bind and Mind Mist lock you in a challenge until solved or expired, while the game keeps moving. At ritual level 3, from two-thirds progress, misdirection can redirect the next chosen target once, unless you first untangle its rune rings. Every curse fades at the following dawn.
rules.curses.difficulty: Early curses have three simple seals to break. At ritual level 2, solve two moderate seals; at level 3, face one harder challenge. Each cleared seal stays cleared, even if you refresh.
rules.ritual.title: The ritual is a race.
rules.ritual.description: When the ritual track fills, the village gets one final discussion and vote. Banish every remaining cultist to win for the town; otherwise the cult summons Cthulhu when that vote resolves. Each cultist can add one step per night by chanting, if their shared mission’s condition is met: chant together, avoid investigation, or keep cultists safe in the previous vote. The cult also wins if no town players remain, or if the final two players are one cultist and one town player.
rules.small_gathering.title: A small gathering, a quicker ritual.
rules.small_gathering.description: With 3 players, the ritual takes 3 steps; with 4, it takes 4. The lone cultist adds one step each night they chant, even if the Oracle investigates them.
rules.ritual_goals.caption: How many steps complete the ritual?
rules.ready.title: Finished discussing?
rules.ready.description: Mark yourself ready for voting. Everyone sees your ready badge, and voting starts as soon as every living player is ready, or when the timer ends.
rules.balance.title: First-edition rules, ready to evolve.
rules.balance.description: Classic has {minPlayers}–{maxPlayers} players and one Oracle. There is 1 cultist with 3–4 players, 2 with 5–6, 3 with 7–8, 4 with 9–12, and 5 with 13–15. In Classic, one cultist is the Veilweaver. Larger gatherings replace an Acolyte with a Dreamweaver and Townsperson seats with special Town roles; see the role guide for their player thresholds. Hosts can choose the Illusions roster with 5+ players for Phantasm, Counterfeiter and Exorcist, plus Oathkeeper at 8+. Default phases last 25 seconds for the reveal, 45 for night, 90 for discussion and 45 for voting. Above 10 players, discussion gains 10 seconds per extra player. The ritual needs 16 steps with 11–12 players and 20 with 13–15. These balance settings are provisional and configurable.
